## Matrix

|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Level `manual` is for a criterion no tool can test (a visual or editorial judgement, a third-party flow without a sandbox, a physical device, a real inbox): its row carries the steps, the tester and the evidence to keep in the Manual column, `—` there on automated rows; the Quality risks section counts them ("N criteria manual").
